scope: Includes all bibliography entries in the supplied October 2026 CV and scholarly works identified in public Google Scholar, University of Surrey and ORCID records, checked on 7 November 2026. Conference posters are presented separately from published papers.
accessLimitations: Coverage is based on the public records available at the verification date; private ORCID works are not included.
yearPolicy: Published papers use verified first-online publication years; public preprints use first-posted years. Posters use CV event years. One CV-only manuscript has no verified publication or posting year.
